commit 9d662e55b5a57b7ca0b8ad23c5b004dbaab13b5d
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 19 11:10:01 2025 +0100
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 19 11:10:01 2025 +0100

    Bug 1848104 - Botan-3 build code update (librnp). [2/2]  r=dandarnell,kaie
    
    
    Update librnp build code for Botan3 changes.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D264507

diff --git a/third_party/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
index 8ed2ef61c25..88347cecde5 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
@@ -74,10 +74,16 @@ rnp_defines = {
     "PACKAGE_BUGREPORT": '"https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/enter_bug.cgi?product=Thunderbird"',
 }
 if CONFIG["MZLA_LIBRNP_BACKEND"] == "botan":
-    LOCAL_INCLUDES += ["!../botan/build/include"]
+    LOCAL_INCLUDES += ["!../botan/build/include/public"]
     if CONFIG["MZLA_SYSTEM_BOTAN"]:
         CXXFLAGS += CONFIG["MZLA_BOTAN_CFLAGS"]
 
+    if CONFIG["OS_TARGET"] == "WINNT":
+        CXXFLAGS += ["/std:c++20"]
+    if CONFIG["OS_TARGET"] != "WINNT":
+        LDFLAGS += ["-pthread"]
+        CXXFLAGS += ["-std=c++20"]
+
     rnp_defines.update({
         "CRYPTO_BACKEND_BOTAN": True,
         "ENABLE_TWOFISH": True,
diff --git a/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
index 2aee291675a..8ae24917bdc 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/src/rnp/moz.build
@@ -17,6 +17,11 @@ LOCAL_INCLUDES = [
     "../lib",
 ]
 
+if CONFIG["OS_TARGET"] == "WINNT":
+    CXXFLAGS += ["/std:c++20"]
+else:
+    CXXFLAGS += ["-std=c++20"]
+
 if CONFIG["MZLA_SYSTEM_JSONC"]:
     CXXFLAGS += CONFIG["MZLA_JSONC_CFLAGS"]
     LDFLAGS += CONFIG["MZLA_JSONC_LIBS"] + ["-Wl,-rpath,$ORIGIN"]
diff --git a/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
index 4c62aeb7cbc..4f2cbd6130d 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/src/rnpkeys/moz.build
@@ -17,6 +17,11 @@ LOCAL_INCLUDES = [
     "../lib",
 ]
 
+if CONFIG["OS_TARGET"] == "WINNT":
+    CXXFLAGS += ["/std:c++20"]
+else:
+    CXXFLAGS += ["-std=c++20"]
+
 if CONFIG["MZLA_SYSTEM_JSONC"]:
     CXXFLAGS += CONFIG["MZLA_JSONC_CFLAGS"]
     LDFLAGS += CONFIG["MZLA_JSONC_LIBS"] + ["-Wl,-rpath,$ORIGIN"]
